run_grid_search: run a grid search over hyperparameter combinations for an EGG game using nest_local
run_sweep_json: run a hyperparameter sweep using a JSON file in stool format with nest_local
run_py_sweep: run a hyperparameter sweep using a Python module with a grid method via nest_local
preview_combinations: preview all hyperparameter combinations without launching jobs using the --preview flag
run_concurrent_jobs: run multiple EGG game jobs concurrently with ProcessPoolExecutor and configurable worker count
